requirements.title: Round edit descriptors temporarily set rounding mode for real and complex formatted I/O
requirements.definition: RU, RD, RZ, RN, RC, and RP temporarily set input/output rounding mode to UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST, COMPATIBLE, and PROCESSOR_DEFINED respectively; the mode affects conversion of real and complex values only for D, E, EN, ES, EX, F, and G editing.

pending.RP-sets-processor-defined: Source-control: RP sets the input/output rounding mode to PROCESSOR_DEFINED. The choice of a processor-defined rounding result is not asserted here and remains dependent on the unregistered rounding-mode semantics.
pending.rounding-affects-real-complex-only-selec: WRITE(buf,'(RU,I1)') 7; expect exactly '7', showing integer output is unaffected.

requirements.oracle:
Plans are pending and source-derived. Positive plans use independent literal expected strings or scalar sentinels. Negative plans change one property from a conforming control and attribute the violation to this unit only.

S13.8.8-001 round-edit-descriptor runtime fixture: one complete program uses RU, RD, RZ, RN, and RC with F editing of exact real values, proving that each descriptor temporarily sets the corresponding 13.7.2.3.8 mode for a selected real formatted output conversion. The asserted fields are '  1.3' for RU on 1.25, '  1.2' for RD on 1.25, ' -1.2' for RZ on -1.25, '  1.1' for RN on non-halfway 1.125, and ' -1.3' for RC on halfway -1.25. RP and the real/complex-only selected-descriptor facet remain pending; no unique processor-defined RP field is asserted.
requirements.oracle_limitation:
Source accounting only. This packet creates no Fortran fixture, compiler invocation, execution evidence, evidence link, fixture approval, oracle approval, or coverage claim. Pending output plans use internal WRITE to a CHARACTER variable and name exact expected characters including blanks when the unit is internally testable. Unnumbered prose restrictions are not promoted to numbered-constraint diagnostics. Where the source makes a behavior processor dependent, or where a rule requires external stream/direct/sequential files or unregistered defined I/O, the pending plan is explicitly source-control or unassertable rather than a fixture oracle. Real rounding depends on unregistered 13.7.2.3.8 and real approximation controls; RP is processor latitude and unassertable as one result. The RP facet records only the mandatory mode-setting effect; any processor-defined rounding choice is source-control/unassertable here.

Rounding-edit fixture boundaries: this packet discharges only RU, RD, RZ, RN, and RC descriptor effects for selected F editing of exactly representable real values. RP and the real/complex-only selected-descriptor facet remain pending. Positive numeric output uses SS, optional leading-zero positions are not asserted, and every descriptor substitution changes the chosen exact value's required field.
requirements.dependencies: Registered dependencies cited, not restated: clauses 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and registered 13.1-13.4 for source form, expressions, intrinsic and character values, execution constructs, FORMAT syntax, edit-descriptor syntax, and format-control interaction. Unregistered dependencies explicitly retained: clause 12 data transfer, connection modes, effective items, and defined I/O; 13.5-13.7.2.4 for format item details and numeric editing; 13.10-13.11 for neighbouring formatting modes; clause 15 for user-defined procedures and defined I/O; clause 16 for NEW_LINE and IEEE inquiries if future fixtures use them; clauses 3, 5, 14, 17, and 19 where future fixture authors need terminology, lexical representation, IEEE arithmetic, interoperability, or scoping/lifetime controls.

review_rationale: Source registration renewed after binding Clause 13 rounding-mode fixtures (batch149). Classification and remaining pending plans re-verified against the pinned text by an independent reviewer, who confirmed 13.7.2.3.8 grants no latitude to substitute an unsupported mode, so the explicit UP, DOWN, ZERO, NEAREST and COMPATIBLE results are required, while NEAREST ties and PROCESSOR_DEFINED remain pending as genuine latitude.
